scenarios.name: Path-scoped discard
notes: A direct tracked-file discard recorded git_worktree before checkout restored the file.

scenarios.name: Patch hunk discard
notes: A direct reverse patch used the same CodeSiteFS path-scoped git_worktree attempt as the route layer.

scenarios.name: Patch target authenticity
notes: A forged discardLines request claimed src/app.js, but the patch targeted api/auth/signup.ts, so CodeSiteFS denied the actual patch target before apply.

scenarios.name: File checkout disambiguation
notes: A branch named src/app.js existed, but discardChange stayed on main and restored the file path using git checkout -- path.

scenarios.name: Repo-wide discardAll gate
notes: A repo-wide discard is blocked by a path-scoped write set and allowed only with ** clearance.

scenarios.name: Conflict operation preflight
notes: Conflict checkout/add methods reject outside-route paths before any git checkout or git add can run.

scenarios.name: Branch checkout broad gate
notes: Direct branch checkout rejects path-scoped leases and switches branches only after a repo-wide git_worktree clearance.

scenarios.name: Stash pop broad gate
notes: Direct stash pop keeps the stash intact under path-scoped clearance and applies it only with repo-wide worktree clearance.

scenarios.name: Merge branch broad gate
notes: Direct mergeBranch performs a CodeSiteFS preflight before fetch or merge can mutate the worktree.

scenarios.name: Pull broad gate
notes: Direct pull performs a CodeSiteFS preflight before any remote merge can change the worktree.

assertions.name: discardChange reverts only after CodeSiteFS allows git_worktree
discardLines reverse-applies patch only after boundary event
discardLines gates the patch header target, not the claimed filePath
discardChange uses file checkout even when a branch shares the path name
discardAll is denied without broad repo clearance and makes no changes
discardAll with ** clearance reverts repo-wide changes
resolve-ours fails closed outside write set
resolve-theirs fails closed outside write set
mark-resolved fails closed outside write set
checkout is blocked before branch switch without ** clearance
checkout with ** clearance records and switches worktree
stashPop is blocked before applying stash without ** clearance
stashPop with ** clearance records and applies stash
mergeBranch is denied before fetch or merge without ** clearance
pull is denied before remote worktree mutation without ** clearance
